literal_meaning: পশুকে চাগাড় (উত্তেজক যন্ত্র) দেওয়া বা লাগানো
figurative_meaning_bn: উত্তেজিত হয়ে ওঠা; প্রবলভাব ধারণ করা
figurative_meaning_en: To become excited or agitated; to intensify strongly
example_sentences_in_english: Foolishness has goaded his mind into excitement.
The debate has riled him up intensely.
note: Origin likely from agricultural practices involving animal herding in Bengal
